segments.name: ACCO Brands Americas
segments.description: Designs, markets, sources, manufactures and sells consumer, technology and business branded products in the U.S., Canada, Brazil, Mexico and Chile.
segments.evidence: Americas includes the U.S., Canada, Brazil, Mexico, and Chile and International includes EMEA, Australia, New Zealand, and Asia.

segments.name: ACCO Brands International
segments.description: Designs, markets, sources, manufactures and sells consumer, technology and business branded products across EMEA, Australia, New Zealand and Asia.
segments.evidence: ACCO Brands has two operating segments based in different geographic regions: Americas and International.

revenueModel.text: The company sells branded consumer, technology and business products to retailers, e-tailers, wholesalers, dealers and other distribution channels, and also sells directly through e-commerce sites and its direct sales organization.
revenueModel.evidence: These channels include mass retailers, e-tailers, discount, drug/grocery and variety chains, warehouse clubs, hardware and specialty stores, independent office product dealers, office superstores, wholesalers, contract stationers, and specialist technology businesses.
